utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If you could help sort donations and maybe pick up a few supplies, that would really ease things for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can sort donations and pick up supplies. Just send me the list and where to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the pickup time and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, fair enough — can you confirm the pickup time and the drop-off place for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I still need the pickup time and the drop-off address first so I can plan properly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Just a screwdriver set and maybe some zip ties if you have them. Thanks, Noah — I knew I was forgetting something.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’ve got those—I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you helping spread the word. That should make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll tell everyone I can and remind them about the date and time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sorry I’m late—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries—there’s still a leaky faucet, a loose porch step, and one screen door that needs patching. If you’ve got time, I can grab the tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the screen door first—grab the tools and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what time are we meeting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s meet at 10 AM by the community center, and please bring gloves, a wrench if you have one, and any spare tape or screws.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—10 AM at the community center works for me. I’ll bring gloves and check for a wrench, tape, and any spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Sam, what exactly still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think the main things left are a leaky faucet, a loose porch step, and a couple of broken outlets. If you want, I can help sort the list by what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please—what should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who might be able to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep you posted on where we need help most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — just send me the details, and I’ll pass them along to the folks I know. Happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help me make a list of the homes that need repairs and maybe reach out to a few neighbors who can volunteer?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I can start the home list and reach out to a few neighbors for volunteers today. Send me any names or details you already have, and I’ll build from there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what supplies we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I really appreciate that. Just send me the list when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do, Bo. I’ll check what we’re short on and send you the list soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still gathering volunteers and tools for the repair drive. If you want, I can pass along the details once I know more.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. Please do—I’d be glad to help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Rey—I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear the time and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me what kind of repairs we’re focusing on for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly the basics—things like leaky faucets, broken shelves, and small electrical fixes. If you’ve got a specific repair in mind, I can help figure out if it fits.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That helps, thanks. Do we need anyone to bring tools, or are you covering those?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Ira, I’m a bit swamped—what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just a quick update—I’m hearing folks could use tools, a tarp, and maybe some gloves. I’ll swing back by if I hear of anything else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—tools, a tarp, and gloves. Thanks for the heads-up; I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and spread the word to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Vik — thanks for helping spread the word. I’m sure a few more neighbors would really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll mention it to a few folks when I’m out. Hopefully we can get a good crowd together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right, I’ve been meaning to ask about that. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly hands and a little time, if you’ve got either. I’m trying to keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can probably spare a bit of time, yeah. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey—if you’re up for it, I could use help sorting donated tools and checking what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can do that. Just tell me when and I’ll help sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Opal — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and I can help line up what’s needed next.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye on what’s where and let you know if I spot anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Opal — that’ll help a lot. I’m going to keep the list updated and make sure everyone knows what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and where we’ll park for the repair drive. Can you send me the details so I can plan it properly?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send over the timing and parking details right away. Thanks for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate that. Once I have the details, I can figure out the best time and where to park.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening—I just want to double-check the details before we go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm what time and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple—what needs fixing, and what time are we heading over?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the bigger stuff—just tell me what’s broken, and I’ll head over a bit late, around 6 if that works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6 works for me. I’ll make a clear list of what needs fixing and we can tackle the bigger stuff first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks were organizing a repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We could really use any spare tools, screws, duct tape, or old extension cords you’ve got. If you can, bring them by the community shed this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that—I’ll gather what I’ve got and drop it by the community shed this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help however I can; just point me to what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren. We could use help sorting donations and checking in with folks who need repairs—does that sound okay?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that sounds good to me. Just tell me where to start, and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school drop-off and pickup times. What time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye. It starts at 10 and should wrap up by 2.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work—I can swing by after drop-off and before pickup. If you need an extra hand, just let me know.
